reviews.text: The best vet I have ever been to. She is very dedicated to my cats and has a lot of knowledge about the health and behavior of the animals. Never another vet for me!
Very veeeery very unfriendly disrespectful woman!! I absolutely do not recommend this clinic!

If it were possible, I would give this clinic 0 stars. I arrived on time for the appointment, but the veterinarian herself was late. During the consultation, she started asking me all kinds of questions about the anatomy of cats. When I indicated that I didn't know that, she reacted very condescendingly with remarks such as: “Haven't you had biology class?”

I only came for a vaccination, but instead of a normal and friendly explanation, I was constantly subjected to arrogant and belittling remarks. The attitude and communication were completely unprofessional and not customer-friendly. I felt very uncomfortable and not taken seriously.

This was the first and last time for me at this clinic. Absolutely not a pleasant experience, and I would personally not recommend this place.

What a terrible vet! My six-month-old kitten was perfectly healthy until this vet spayed her. She was hypothermic and only had a temperature of 34 degrees Celsius. When she got home, she deteriorated and became increasingly lethargic. She was admitted there on Thursday, and by Friday morning my kitten had died. Very strange, except that the vet was acting like a know-it-all.
Excellent vet, goes 100% for your animal; perhaps a bit tougher with the owners, but ultimately, it is about the animal.

My cat isn't even registered here, and I'm never going to be. I happened to pass by this clinic while out for a walk and wanted some information, because it's only a 5 to 10 minute walk from my house. Very unfriendly woman, very arrogant, very unpleasant. She didn't let me finish speaking at all when I was telling her something and told me exactly how I "MUST" raise my cat.. My cat is 5, I think I know what my cat is like by then... When I said that to her as well, I got a snap of "So who's the professional here?" 🫠
I can tell you: I am not going to register my cat here... I'd rather travel the extra distance to Osdorp where they know my cat, than go to this unpleasant woman.

Very unfriendly, didn't want to give my kitten back, very nasty person, very unprofessional. My friend is blocked via phone, gives no update on how my kitten is doing, only arrived at her workplace around 11:30, while there were other cats there who also just needed help. She thought she knew everything better, even though I have a background in animals, attended animal school, everything, so I really do know a thing or two. So, a very bad experience. I have never experienced anything like this before, so don't go here!!!!

The lady arrives 15 minutes late and when I ask if she had any trouble on the way I get a blunt/strange answer “no I never look at the time I just leave the house and I don’t cycle to you” (that’s no reason to be late but okay) I was inside for maybe 30 minutes in total it felt like hours because to everything we said or asked she gave very blunt and demeaning answers one of the many examples is my mother getting a call inside mother answers says I’m at the clinic for the cat I’ll call you back in a moment the phone conversation lasts literally 5 seconds the moment my mother answers she says in an authoritarian tone and pointing at my mother “Hang up the phone now in my clinic no one is calling” that was the last straw for me and I spoke to her that she shouldn’t point like that and give orders which does happen and not that she could also ask in a normal way and that if she had a little patience she would have seen that she was hung up immediately and a few stupid comments like is that how it works in Turkey in the clinic too? Turkish vets are terrible, what does Turkey have to do with this? Haha. You can be an animal lover, but apparently haven't learned how to communicate with people. It's a shame this is the first and last time I've been here!
Very satisfied with her and she knows what she is talking about. I have been coming here for quite some time with both my cats, Chucky and El-Macho.

Nicky is an incredibly sweet and skilled veterinarian. She takes plenty of time for you and your pet and provides very good, targeted tips and creative solutions. She is one of the few veterinarians whose practice has not been swallowed up by a large corporation, which means things remain affordable. And whether it concerns an injured animal or a shelter, Nicky is also always ready to help the animal ambulance and/or people who are not so well-off. A big thumbs up for the practice!

Poor service, and they wouldn't give me my pet back.

My cats always have to stay longer after surgeries compared to other veterinary clinics, which I immediately noticed.
Because I have a special breed cat, they tried to take it away from me by involving authorities, which is utter nonsense. This is purely because of my cat's breed.

From now on, I'll go to Osdorp Veterinary Clinic; it's 100 percent better than this dump.
Today my cat had his area treated. She took the time to calm my cat down and explain the treatment. She cares about animals.

Very unfriendly, as described earlier. Aside from the fact that she makes you wait OUTSIDE the clinic and not in the waiting room, I am not at all pleased with her treatment. It is fine if your love for animals is great, but that is no …
I come here for my cat. Always satisfied and well helped.

When my mother went for an appointment for our kitten 2 weeks ago, the lady said that my mother could leave the kitten at the clinic for surgery while she only needed to do the vaccination – totally crazy! After that, she went to the …
